room_rent.note: Room rent limit is mentioned as per Policy Schedule; no explicit cap stated in wording

icu.note: ICU charges covered under inpatient benefit; specific limit not stated in wording

copayment.note: Base plan has no mandatory co-pay. C5 add-on: 10% if treated at non-tiered network. C22 add-on: agreed co-pay as per schedule.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments sub-limited; optional disease sub-limits add-on
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments capped (e.g. Robotic Surgery 50% of SI up to ₹5L, Oral Chemo 10% up to ₹1L). Optional C4 add-on introduces disease-wise sub-limits (cataract, hernia, ENT, etc.) in exchange for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Reducible to 12 months via optional C11 add-on (PED Waiting Period Waiver)

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers listed conditions e.g. cataract, hernia, ENT, joint replacement etc.

maternity.note: Inbuilt under Section I C14; limit as per schedule; only for spouse; first 2 deliveries; age 18-45. Optional C8 add-on reduces wait to 24 months.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 50% (10%/yr) for SI ≤10L; up to 100% (20%/yr) for SI 15L–50L
cumulative_bonus.note: Plans Basic/Essential/Privilege/Digi-Pro: 10%/yr up to 50%. Plans Plus/Premier/Executive: 20%/yr up to 100%. Bonus reduced on claim.

restoration.note: Restored SI usable for different illness only (same-illness restriction lifted for floater family members). Optional C10 add-on removes the unrelated-illness restriction.

pre_hosp.note: Standard 30 days; extended to 60 days if medical documents and hospitalization details provided 5 days in advance. Optional C6 add-on extends base to 90 days.

post_hosp.note: Standard 60 days; extended to 90 days if prior intimation given. Optional C7 add-on extends to 120 days.

day_care.note: Extensive list of named procedures covered; not all day-care automatically covered

domiciliary.display: Covered up to 20% of base SI
domiciliary.note: Allopathic only; condition must last ≥3 days; 12 named conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH covered; limit as per schedule; cannot claim allopathic for same illness simultaneously

organ_donor.note: Donor pre/post-hospitalisation not covered under base; optional C18 add-on covers donor pre/post-hosp expenses

ambulance.note: Limit specified in Policy Schedule; inter-hospital transfer also covered if prescribed by doctor

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered with individual caps (e.g. Robotic Surgery 50% of SI up to ₹5L; Oral Chemo 10% up to ₹1L)

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items in List-I excluded by default; covered up to schedule limit via C9 add-on

global_cover.note: Covers inpatient/day-care outside India up to SI; diagnosis must be in India; prior written approval required; max 180 consecutive days

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual; 15 days for monthly instalment

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 45 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment (base), treatment outside India (base), refractive error <7.5D, domiciliary for 12 named conditions, dental/cosmetic, war/nuclear

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Daily Cash, Sub-limits, Global Cover, PED waiver (12mo), Consumables, Maternity wait reduction, Obesity/Infertility cover, Premium Waiver
